subject.title: feat: generic session discussion seam with Control UI panel

question: Should OpenClaw expose a single process-wide public session-discussion provider API in the core plugin SDK, rather than keep the initial integration owner-specific until its identity and lifecycle contract is proven?
rationale: The proposed module is a new public plugin SDK and gateway contract; maintainers must choose its permanent ownership, session identity, and multi-provider model before compatibility commitments are made.

options.title: Sponsor the generic seam
options.body: Keep the generic core API, but require agent-qualified identity, lifecycle-safe registration, and focused multi-agent rollback coverage before merge.

options.title: Keep it owner-specific first
options.body: Move the first implementation into the discussion integration until a broader plugin SDK contract has multiple concrete consumers.

options.title: Pause the feature direction
options.body: Defer the public API until maintainers choose the intended provider cardinality and product ownership model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the generic seam
recommendation.body: Keep the generic core API, but require agent-qualified identity, lifecycle-safe registration, and focused multi-agent rollback coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This author implemented the proposed seam and is the only concrete feature-routing candidate established by the supplied branch history.
